Some monsters are Infused with an element, shown as [Fire], [Water], [Wind], [Earth], [Holy] or [Dark], with a glow of that element.

It attacks with its element and resists it, but is weak to the opposite one: Fire and Water, Wind and Earth, Holy and Dark. Bring a weapon of the opposite element and armor of the same one.

It has twice the HP, and while you stand close it casts a great nova of its element. The spell takes a few seconds: step away.

An Infused monster drops attribute stones of its element, and at high levels sometimes a crystal. Use them on your weapon and armor to give them that attribute.
